image_description: A single Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming against a textured, dark reddish-brown coral or rock background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and golden-yellow posterior body/tail. The image has a slightly grainy, underwater aesthetic.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution is insufficient to verify 'brush-like teeth' or the specific 'protrusible' nature of the mouth. The mouth area is visible but lacks the detail required for this specific biological checkpoint.
The eye is clearly visible on the black portion of the head, appearing large relative to the head size, consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish exhibits a distinct oval/disc shape typical of angelfish/butterflyfish, appearing laterally compressed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color pattern matches perfectly: the front half is black, the back half is yellow/gold. There appears to be a thin dark margin on the tail fin, though subtle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin runs continuously along the top edge. While individual spines vs rays are hard to distinguish due to resolution, the continuous structure is present.
The anal fin on the ventral side mirrors the dorsal fin's position and general shape.
The caudal fin (tail) is visibly rounded, not forked or truncated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background texture has a slightly repetitive, noisy quality common in AI-generated underwater scenes, lacking distinct geological features.
Slight softness around the fins and body edges, likely simulating underwater refraction or motion blur, but could also indicate generation smoothing.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed Holocanthus tricolor and not a similar angelfish species.
To ensure the fins are properly connected to the body and not melting into the background or having floating segments.
To assess if the graininess and blur are artistic choices or artifacts of poor generation quality.
To verify the fish sits correctly in the 3D space of the water without weird clipping into the background.

focus_areas: Color boundary sharpness between black and yellow regions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the black and yellow parts of the fish; AI often blurs this line unnaturally. Also, check if the dorsal and anal fins have realistic transparency or thickness, as they often appear like solid plastic sheets in bad generations.
